summary: Douglas County lookout from 1921-22; 1958 concrete base tower with the cab removed in 2001. The register says the concrete tower is now a radio building.

facts.design: Two-story concrete base tower with an Amort cab (1958), after an earlier cupola cabin
facts.status_note: Cab removed in 2001; the concrete tower remains and is used as a radio building, per the register.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the first cupola cabin to 1922. Rex's page reports the lookout house on top completed in October 1921 and says in June 1922 that the lookout 'was built last year.' The story gives both dates.

The register calls the 1958 structure a two-story concrete base tower with an Amort cab. firelookout.com calls it a 10-foot concrete base with an ODF cab. Both agree on a concrete base finished in 1958.

corrections.why: The register says the cab was removed in 2001 but the concrete tower is now used as a radio building, so the concrete structure survives. Editor to confirm the status wording, since the lookout cab itself is gone.

notes_for_editor: The brief's status 'gone' conflicts with the register, which says the concrete tower is now a radio building. This record proposes 'standing' with a status note; the editor should confirm the wording. The brief's 1922 build date matches the register and firelookout.com, but Rex's page has the lookout house completed in October 1921. firelookout.com's header 'R.I.P. 1922-1958' was not used because it does not match its own text or the other sources. No source describes the current condition of the concrete tower or whether the site is open to visitors. The brief's 2001 removal and Oregon Department of Forestry agency are supported. Searches found nothing on the site's current state.
